findings.summary: SGDR repair round 1 verifiably closed the prior audit's R1–R3 without weakening the preregistered test: git diff between round-0 and round-1 commits is empty over all experiment code and raw evidence; 18-file SHA256 manifest verifies with hash deltas matching the attestation exactly (6/10 frozen, 4 drifted, each with a disclosed pre-outcome bugfix annotation; pre-change bytes declared unrecoverable); prereg byte-identical above its declared erratum separator; R3 canonical URL corrected to https://github.com/plusnli/online-skill-learning (repository rename verified live by the auditor; supersedes stale Scout-record URL plusnli/skill-dynamic-retrieval). Auditor's own from-prereg reimplementation (own embedder/scorer/MMR/A-channel/truth sets, importing nothing) reproduced 522/522 ranking rows, every aggregate and the cluster table; evaluator sandbox rerun regenerated retrieval_eval.json byte-identically; selftests 7/7.

Measurement re-confirmed end-to-end from raw evidence at this round: hard-slice correct@1 = incumbent goal_sig 0/74 vs task-only 25/74 vs fused SGDR 36/74 with 11–0 pairwise dominance; conversion novel actions 21/42/39 (literal) and 400/42/36 (paraphrase) at success thresholds .60/.80/.90. Frozen rule outcome REPRODUCED_USEFUL with per-slice caveat correctly disclosed. Mechanism status carried as VALIDATED_USEFUL at PROOF OF CONCEPT tier; gate REVISE only for documentary defects below. Final acceptance into lab/intel is already captured elsewhere (run 32800296360 / fca0acb).

New defect found BY this round's audit, in this round's own additions — RF1: the erratum claimed wrong-state-summary, summary-only AND constant-dummy fusion all 'fall back to baseline (24/74)', but the auditor's rescan showed the constant-dummy control is STRING-DEPENDENT: 19–36/74 depending on the chosen dummy text (36 equals the real condition), caused by sha1 bucket collisions in the lexical-hash embedder at d=512. A fragile result had been presented as uniform fact. RF2: cost footnote '11+2 would-be LLM calls' not supported by artifacts (11 collection misses verified; conversion counters show 2 misses but committed conversion cache holds only 1 novel key). Both fixed documentary-only in round 2.

Methodological lesson now twice-validated inside one cycle: any fusion null-control built on a lexical-hash embedder needs collision-safe construction or larger dimension; constant-text controls are unstable at d=512. This refines the accepted ledger's ablation interpretation (wrong-context-summary 24/74 and summary-only 24/74 are the stable controls; constant-text is not citable as evidence).

~48m52s total wall clock: scout ~5s (snapshot reuse), reproducer 28m21s of which ~13m lost to two transient provider outages ('Error from provider (Console): Upstream request failed: Endpoint is unavailable', 300s backoff each, attempts 1-2 of 6 wasted), auditor 20m07s including full independent reimplementation. 36 stall-watch warnings ('OpenCode/Ox network signature detected; watching for a 300s stall') across reproducer+auditor added polling overhead but no aborts.
